units: R. Hash. 8ᵃ (Tosaf. pl.); a. e.—Esp. turn of the sun, solstice; תְּקוּפַת ניסן vernal equinox; ת׳ תמוז summer solstice; ת׳ תשרי autumnal equinox; ת׳ טבת winter solstice.

Snh. 11ᵇ; Tosef. ib. II, 2 על שלשה … ועל הת׳ we declare a leap-year for three reasons: on account of the spring crop, on account of the fruits of the trees, and on account of the solstice; a. fr.—Pl. תְּקוּפוֹת.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:18">Ab. III, 18</cite> <he>ת׳</he> the calculation of cycles (astronomy), v. <cite ref="Q01967"><he>פַּרְפֶּרֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 75a">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>היודע לתשב ת׳ ומזלות וכ׳</he> he who understands the science of cycles and planets and does not practice it; a. e.
